newsitem.title: UK: Euromoney buys 40 pct in UK's Mondiale Corp.
newsitem.headline: Euromoney buys 40 pct in UK's Mondiale Corp.

text.p: Business and industry magazine publisher Euromoney Publications Plc said on Wednesday it had bought 40 percent interest in another British business publishing firm, Mondiale Corp Ltd.
The total consideration is dependent on the results of Mondiale for the year ending December 31, 1997 but it will be capped at 4.5 million stg.
A pre-payment of four million stg comprising 400,000 stg in cash and 3.6 million stg in unsecured loan notes will be made at completion.
Mondiale, specialising in international office products market, reported pre-tax profits after exceptional costs of 486,700 stg on sales of 1.6 million stg.
Euromoney has a put and call option to buy the remaining 60 percent stake from its holders Michael Jefferies and Stephen Hilleard by December 31, 2001.
The total consideration for the 60 percent stake has been capped at 15.5 million stg.
